form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Grassley introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance

form.official-title: To extend the Generalized System of Preferences, and for other purposes.

section.header: Extension of Generalized System of Preferences
section.text: Section 505 of the Trade Act of 1974 (19 U.S.C. 2465) is amended by striking December 31, 2020 and inserting April 30, 2022.

subsection.text: Section 13031(j)(3) of the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1985 (19 U.S.C. 58c(j)(3)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subparagraph (A), by striking September 30, 2029 and inserting November 18, 2029; and
in subparagraph (B)(i), by striking September 30, 2029 and inserting November 18, 2029.

subsection.text: Section 503 of the United States–Korea Free Trade Agreement Implementation Act (Public Law 112–41; 19 U.S.C. 3805 note) is amended by striking September 30, 2029 and inserting November 18, 2029.
